sources.note: p.323: 'The accent in Lau, where noticeable, is on the first syllable, and the voice is raised at the end of the sentence with a stressing of the penultimate syllable.' -- statement about LAU proper (lauu1247), not Gula'alaa; nearest-relative proxy only (Ethnologue: 85% lexical similarity, possibly intelligible).
